newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-AGENCY LAUNCHES LIETUVA HOTEL TENDER.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-AGENCY LAUNCHES LIETUVA HOTEL TENDER.

text.p: Lithuania's privatisation agency said on Thursday that it has launched an open tender for the country's largest hotel, the Hotel Lietuva.
"Privatisation offers will be accepted from September 1 to September 26 and the winner of the tender is expected to be known by October 2," Grazhina Vezheliene told Reuters.
Vezheliene also said the terms of reference for the hotel selloff can be obtained between August 18 and September 15.
"The initial price for the hotel was set at 44 million litas," Vezheliene said.
The hotel has 316 rooms and is owned 70.04 percent by the state. It posted a net profit of 817,000 litas and turnover of 10.7 million litas in 1996.
